oral_examination.oral_examination: 47 The filling body can be seen on the mesial and interproximal (occlusal) surface, and secondary caries can be seen on the edge. Percussion ( ) and probing ( ) show no difference.

treatment_plan.notes: Avoid biting hard food, pay attention to oral hygiene, and return to the clinic regularly. Eat and drink after 2 hours.

source_handle: Local iodophor disinfection, 2% lidocaine block anesthesia, 4% articaine local infiltration anesthesia, gingival separation, gap enlargement, loosening, forceps removal, scraping, cotton ball compression to stop bleeding.
